{{Quote|During my time manning rigs on Subterrel, I'd occasionally use one of the low-volume mining sluices to prepare this tasty stew, made with ripe apple slugs, Ojomian onions, space-carrots and a pinch of negamo. Today, we make the stew more traditionally, in a pot on a nanowave stove, but it's just as flavorful as ever.|Dexter Jettster, menu for Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
The '''apple slug''' was a type of [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slug]] that shared its name with the [[Apple/Legends|apple]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. When the<ref name="Dex" /> [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]]<ref name="CSWE Dex">{{CSWECite|II|160|Jettster, Dexter}}</ref> [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] was working as a [[Miner/Legends|miner]] on<ref name="Dex" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Subterrel">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Subterrel system/Legends|Subterrel system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Insider80">{{InsiderCite|80|The Unseen Planets of Episode II}}</ref> [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]],<ref name="Dex" /> he<ref name="CSWE Dex" /> would sometimes use ripe apple slugs as an ingredient in preparing the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] known as [[apple slug stew]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later,<ref name="Dex" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}},</ref> after Jettster had become a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and the owner of the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the<ref name="Dex" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he included the [[Stew/Legends|stew]], as well as [[apple slug sauce]], on the establishment's menu.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I have a fondness for abandoned concepts, hence the inclusion of the donut droid as well as references to Revwiens, Adarians, apple slugs and even Kenner's Mongo Beefhead Tribesman. (The Revwiens and Adarians are cut concepts that had already been brought into canon, but I believe this is the first time any allusion to the apple slugs or the Mongo Beefhead Tribesman has made it into an official piece.)|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}.</ref>}}
[[File:Apple_slug_maquette.png|thumb|right|250px|The "Apple Slug" maquette created for ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]
As first documented in the [[1995]] book ''[[From Star Wars to Indiana Jones: The Best of the Lucasfilm Archives]]'' by [[Mark Cotta Vaz]] and [[Shinji Hata]], "Apple Slug" was a nickname given by the team of Creature Design Supervisor [[Phil Tippett]] of the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], to one of the several [[Alien/Legends|alien]] lifeforms slated to appear in the sequences of the film taking place at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]<ref name="TBOTLA">''[[From Star Wars to Indiana Jones: The Best of the Lucasfilm Archives]]''</ref> on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TEA" />

The design was realized as a prototype maquette, which depicted it as a mound-shaped alien with wrinkled, [[Color/Legends|green]] skin; a gaping [[Mouth/Legends|maw]] with a red
[[Tongue/Legends|tongue]]; and four segmented, hooked, black [[Limb/Legends|appendages]].<ref name="TBOTLA" /> The concept was eventually abandoned and not used in the film; however, [[Gregory Walker]] intentionally referenced it<ref name="Blog" /> via a mention of the "apple slug" in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive [[StarWars.com]] article "[[Dining at Dex's]]."<ref name="Dex" />
